notes: Three independent competencies must all be met for full reward. (1) A git post-receive hook must deploy pushed branch trees to /app/deployed/<branch> (mirroring file trees byte-for-byte, updating in place, removing on branch delete, and safely ignoring non-branch refs while never writing outside the served root). (2) A URL normalizer must convert trailing-slash, query-ordering, default-port and case variants to one canonical form and stay idempotent over malformed/blank lines. (3) Each paper in the bundled index must be enumerated from the HTML and its author-maintained repository resolved by cross-referencing the affiliation org against candidate repo URLs; the mapping is validated by re-parsing all papers, including missing-detail and missing-affiliation edge cases. Reasoning depth is high because the deployed tree must exactly mirror the pushed branch trees (byte-equality), and the paper mapping must be derived from parsing + cross-referencing, not from a visible list.
